info.description: Adds the missing allow_auto_merge property to the repos/update request body until upstream spec is fixed: https://github.com/github/rest-api-description/issues/6902

allow_auto_merge.description: Either `true` to allow auto-merge on pull requests, or `false` to disallow auto-merge. https://github.com/github/rest-api-description/issues/6902
